wokwi-esp32-devkit-v1.description: ESP32 DevKit v1 board. GPIO pins are named D<n>. D34, D35, VN, VP are input-only.

wokwi-led.description: Single-colour LED. attrs.color: red, green, blue, yellow, white, orange.

wokwi-rgb-led.description: Common-cathode RGB LED. COM to ground, R/G/B through resistors.

wokwi-resistor.description: Resistor. attrs.value in ohms as a string, e.g. "220".

wokwi-pushbutton.description: Momentary pushbutton. Pins 1.l/1.r are one side, 2.l/2.r the other. attrs.color optional.

wokwi-slide-switch.description: SPDT slide switch. Pin 2 is common; 1 and 3 are the two positions.

wokwi-potentiometer.description: Rotary potentiometer. SIG to an ADC-capable pin.

wokwi-buzzer.description: Piezo buzzer. Pin 1 to GPIO, pin 2 to ground.

wokwi-servo.description: Hobby servo. PWM to a GPIO, V+ to 5V or VIN, GND to ground.

wokwi-dht22.description: DHT22 temperature and humidity sensor. SDA is the data pin. Use the DHT sensor library.

wokwi-hc-sr04.description: HC-SR04 ultrasonic distance sensor. TRIG output, ECHO input.

wokwi-photoresistor-sensor.description: LDR module with analog (AO) and digital (DO) outputs.

wokwi-ntc-temperature-sensor.description: NTC thermistor module with analog OUT.

wokwi-pir-motion-sensor.description: PIR motion sensor. OUT goes high on motion.

wokwi-mpu6050.description: MPU6050 6-axis IMU over I2C (SDA, SCL). Address 0x68.

wokwi-ds18b20.description: DS18B20 one-wire temperature sensor. DQ is the data pin, needs a pull-up.

wokwi-lcd1602.description: 16x2 character LCD. Use SCL/SDA for the I2C backpack (LiquidCrystal_I2C, address 0x27).

wokwi-lcd2004.description: 20x4 character LCD. Use SCL/SDA for the I2C backpack (address 0x27).

wokwi-7segment.description: Seven-segment display. attrs.digits sets number of digits.

wokwi-neopixel.description: Single WS2812 NeoPixel. DIN from GPIO, DOUT to the next pixel.

wokwi-membrane-keypad.description: 4x4 membrane keypad. Rows R1-R4, columns C1-C4. Use the Keypad library.

wokwi-ky-040.description: KY-040 rotary encoder. CLK, DT for rotation, SW for the push.

wokwi-relay-module.description: Relay module. IN from GPIO; NO/NC/COM are the switched contacts.

wokwi-stepper-motor.description: Bipolar stepper. Needs a driver; A+/A-/B+/B- are coil ends.

wokwi-ir-receiver.description: IR receiver. DAT to GPIO. Use IRremote.

wokwi-analog-joystick.description: Two-axis joystick with push. VERT/HORZ analog, SEL digital.

wokwi-microsd-card.description: MicroSD over SPI. CS, SCK, DI (MOSI), DO (MISO).
